items.informal_name: Membership in Ideal Generated by Range Characterized by Finite Sums
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] {x : R} {v : α → R},
  x ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range v) ↔ ∃ c, (c.sum fun i a => a * v i) = x
items.informal_description: For a semiring $ R $ and a function $ v : \alpha \to R $, an element $ x \in R $ belongs to the ideal generated by the image of $ v $ if and only if there exists a finite support function $ c : \alpha \to_0 R $ such that $ x = \sum_{i \in \mathrm{support}(c)} c(i) \cdot v(i) $. This characterizes ideal membership in terms of finite $ R $-linear combinations of the function's values.

items.informal_name: Ideal Membership via Finite Linear Combinations
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Fintype α] {x : R} {v : α → R},
  x ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range v) ↔ ∃ c, ∑ i, c i * v i = x
items.informal_description: For a finite type $\alpha$ and a semiring $R$, an element $x \in R$ belongs to the ideal generated by the set $\{v(i) \mid i \in \alpha\}$ if and only if there exists a function $c : \alpha \to R$ such that $x = \sum_{i \in \alpha} c(i) \cdot v(i)$.

items.informal_name: Image of Element Under Function Lies in Generated Ideal
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Semiring α] {β : Type u_1} {f : β → α} {x : β}, f x ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range f)
items.informal_description: For any function $ f: \beta \to \alpha $ and any element $ x \in \beta $, the image $ f(x) $ is contained in the ideal generated by the range of $ f $.

items.informal_name: Ideal Membership Characterized by Basis Linear Combinations
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : CommSemiring R] [inst_2 : Semiring S]
  [inst_3 : Algebra R S] {I : Ideal S} (b : Module.Basis ι R ↥I) {x : S}, x ∈ I ↔ ∃ c, x = ∑ i, c i • ↑(b i)
items.informal_description: For any finite type $\iota$, commutative semiring $R$, semiring $S$ with an $R$-algebra structure, and ideal $I \subseteq S$, an element $x \in S$ belongs to $I$ if and only if there exist coefficients $c_i \in R$ such that $x = \sum_{i \in \iota} c_i \cdot b_i$, where $\{b_i\}$ is an $R$-basis for $I$.

items.informal_name: Ideal Membership Criterion for Two Generators
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Semiring α] {x y z : α}, z ∈ Ideal.span {x, y} ↔ ∃ a b, a * x + b * y = z
items.informal_description: An element $ z $ belongs to the ideal generated by the set $ \{x, y\} $ in a semiring $ \alpha $ if and only if there exist elements $ a, b \in \alpha $ such that $ z = a x + b y $.
